hypothesis: Blind faults retain a contrast-invariant multi-scale local-phase step (monogenic phase congruency) even where gradient amplitude is too weak for HGM/tilt/worm detectors and for catalogue mapping.
mechanism: Riesz-transform monogenic signal on RTP / isostatic gravity / detrended elevation / depth-to-basement; DoG scales sigma=1,2,4 px; per-source phase congruency + 3 amplitudes + mean-phase cos/sin + orientation coherence (+Frangi bright/dark on RTP & det-elev) = 32 MPC-family features added to a 48-band geophysics+topo+lidar+radiometric stack (80 total); leave-one-quadrant-out HistGradientBoosting on visible catalogue only (negatives EDT>3px, 4:1); spaced greedy emission (min_dist 2.5 px) to exactly 37,654 dots at EDT(catalogue)>2.5 px (min realised 2.83 px).
mimic_nonfault_process: Lithologic contacts and aeromagnetic flight-line levelling seams are also phase-coherent step edges; they can mimic fault phase congruency with no fault present.

holdout.protocol: shared vendor/gems57: buffered whole-component hide-and-recover, seed 20, feature buffer 3 px, boundary erosion 12 px, visible faults masked pixel-exactly, pooled DTI alpha 0.2 beta 0.8, 300 m triangular kernel; CIs = 20 km spatial-block paired bootstrap (1000 draws)
holdout.instrument_identity_verified: controls reproduced: h33_analogue_foldfair and random match GEMSDOE73/GEMSDOE77 published values on this instrument

pass1_preregistered_emitter_reading_IR-7.note: As preregistered, vendor greedy_allocate+top-up produced contiguous dot runs (98.9% of dots with neighbour <=1.5 px, median NN 1.0 px), a defective geometry under the 300 m kernel. Those scores are retained here, not deleted: E2 0.0471 / E1 0.0366 / E3 0.0128 / control 0.0939 / random 0.0484 (evidence/h78mpc_experiments.json). Pass-2 re-emitted the FROZEN surfaces with the control's spaced emitter; no retraining. The MPC-vs-base paired effect is significant under BOTH emitters (+0.0105 clustered, +0.0121 spaced).

holdout.caveat: Candidate-vs-control paired delta is +0.0038 with 95% CI [-0.012, +0.020]: the point estimate beats the fold-fair H33 control but the advantage is NOT statistically significant. Holdout truth is the visible catalogue, so this instrument cannot reward genuinely new-fault geometry beyond catalogue-like structure (proxy limitation).
